newsitem.title: USA: Trans-Lux signs multi-million NYMEX pact.
newsitem.headline: Trans-Lux signs multi-million NYMEX pact.

text.p: Trans-Lux Corp said Thursday it has signed a multimillion-dollar contract with the New York Mercantile Exchange to install electronic price reporting systems on NYMEX's new trading floors.
The company said the contract is the largest it has received but declined to disclose an exact amount.
Trans-Lux shares gained 1-3/8 Thursday afternoon to 12-1/2.

The order calls for Trans-Lux to install electronic price reporting systems and other financial information displays for NYMEX's new building, which will open in Manhattan's financial district in 1997.
Trans-Lux said the displays will cover 10,000 square feet of wall space.
The company said it is recognizing revenue from the contract on a percentage of completion basis that will extend into 1997.
